name: SOC 2 evidence collector
description: Aggregates the evidence the operator's other playbooks already emit into a dated SOC 2 readiness attestation. Reads the Trust Services Criteria crosswalk under content/mappings/soc2/, maps each available evidence reference onto the criteria it supports, scores per-criterion coverage, and reports one attestation naming what is covered, what is uncovered, and what rests on draft mappings. It collects no new telemetry and asserts no audit opinion — SOC 2 attestation is a licensed auditor's act, and this playbook produces readiness input, not a report.

__assessment_window__.description: ISO-8601 interval the attestation covers. Operator-declared.

__evidence_refs__.description: Evidence references available for the window, each carrying its artifact_id, stream and the criteria refs it claims to support.

__criteria_atoms__.description: Per-criterion atoms read from the SOC 2 crosswalk, each carrying its category, control refs, playbook refs and mapping status.

__criteria_mapping__.description: Which evidence reference supports which criterion.

__coverage_scoring__.description: Per-criterion coverage verdict plus the category rollup.

__attestation_id__.description: Deterministic id of the emitted readiness attestation.

__workflow_id__.description: Runtime-supplied: content-model slug of the workflow that ran.

__owner_role__.description: Role-shaped owner of the readiness posture; a role, never a person.

__crosswalk_entries__.description: The SOC 2 crosswalk entries to score against, read from content/mappings/soc2/*.yaml by the adapter. Passed in as data so the criteria set is not hard-coded in this playbook.

action--b7c2e5a1-0000-4000-8000-00000000.name: collect criteria atoms
action--b7c2e5a1-0000-4000-8000-00000000.description: Read the Trust Services Criteria crosswalk under content/mappings/soc2/ into per-criterion atoms. The criteria set is data, not a constant in this playbook, so a criterion added to the crosswalk is scored on the next run without a content change here.

action--b7c2e5a1-0000-4000-8000-00000000.name: map evidence to criteria
action--b7c2e5a1-0000-4000-8000-00000000.description: Join the evidence references available for the window onto the criteria they support. An evidence reference naming a criterion the crosswalk does not carry is reported as unmatched rather than silently dropped.

action--b7c2e5a1-0000-4000-8000-00000000.name: score per-criterion coverage
action--b7c2e5a1-0000-4000-8000-00000000.description: Score each criterion as covered, partially covered or uncovered, and roll the result up per Trust Services category. Coverage resting on a draft mapping is counted separately — a draft crosswalk entry is not audit-ready evidence.

action--b7c2e5a1-0000-4000-8000-00000000.name: report readiness attestation
action--b7c2e5a1-0000-4000-8000-00000000.description: Emit one dated readiness attestation naming covered, partially covered and uncovered criteria, the draft-backed subset, and the owner. It is readiness input for an auditor, never an audit opinion.

sources: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, as revised) — the criteria set this playbook scores coverage against, via content/mappings/soc2/
content/mappings/soc2/README.md — every crosswalk entry is status: draft, which the scoring step surfaces rather than smoothing over
docs/cookbook/soc2_crosswalk.md — SOC 2 is not an EU statutory instrument; the EU mappings remain the authoritative statutory pointer
